mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vacation ( member_id, vacation_type, start_date, end_date, reason ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{vacationType}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{reason} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM vacation WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY start_date DESC
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM vacation WHERE status = '승인' AND DATE(DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 9 HOUR)) BETWEEN start_date AND end_date
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vacation WHERE status = '대기'
SELECT vacation_id, member_id, vacation_type, start_date, end_date, reason, status FROM vacation WHERE status = '대기' ORDER BY start_date ASC LIMIT 5
mapper.update: UPDATE vacation SET status = '승인' WHERE vacation_id = #{vacationId} AND status = '대기'
UPDATE vacation SET status = '반려' WHERE vacation_id = #{vacationId} AND status = '대기'
